meta.title: Multi-device config sync
meta.description: Back up your DSH profile to a GitHub Gist. Open Multi-device config sync in the Settings sidebar to preview file changes and missing plugins before confirming a restore. Use a trusted Gist; undo restores configuration only, not packages.

title: Multi-device config sync
subtitle: Move your configuration and plugins between computers.
pluginsHint: The backup does not contain plugin packages. Review the names and sources of missing plugins before allowing installation.
newMachineTitle: Using this on a new machine
newMachineStep1: Install Multi-device config sync in the target profile.
newMachineStep2: Choose Restore from backup and use the linked backup or paste a trusted link from another machine.
newMachineStep3: Review file changes, plugin sources and items that need manual setup. Address GitHub access only if prompted.
newMachineStep4: Confirm only if you trust the plan. Review the results, handle pending builds separately and restart DSH as indicated.
tokenHelp: Use the token field, DSH_GITHUB_TOKEN / GITHUB_TOKEN on the host, or a signed-in gh CLI. Do not share tokens or Gist links.
